prep: no prep/ folder; plan, audits and comparators built by the writer; published topic tables reused append-only

inherited.M05: grayscale 96x96 mouth ROI at 25 fps plus raw 16 kHz waveform (LiRA/Ma et al. pipeline)
inherited.M06: ResNet-18 front end + Transformer encoder, hybrid CTC/attention with 1,000 SentencePiece units (ESPnet lineage)
inherited.M07: Transformer LM by shallow fusion, beam 40 (Ma et al. 2022 lineage)

topics.inclusion_rule: Self-supervised or teacher-generated pre-training on unlabelled non-audio-only input before supervised fine-tuning for speech/text decoding; exclude audio-only SSL and studies that only reuse a released checkpoint (published rule kept).
topics.pattern: published pattern (self-supervised | masked prediction | contrastive pre-train | unlabelled video/data)
topics.fulltext_pattern: momentum encoder/teacher, EMA teacher or slowly-evolving teacher within 300 characters of lip / visual speech / video / audio-visual
topics.metric: LRS3 VSR WER at a fixed labelled budget (30 h / 433 h) and fixed unlabelled data (LRS3 433 h or LRS3+VoxCeleb2 1,759 h)
topics.time_window: prior = first public before 2022-06; [concurrent] = 2022-06 to 2023-06; ledger years only give the year, so 'at the target's time' = year <= 2022

topics.inclusion_rule: Lip-reading and video-to-speech studies that use only lip/face video at test and use paired audio or a speech model in training to enrich the visual model (distillation, audio-feature regression, audio memory); exclude audio-visual models needing audio at test (published rule kept).
topics.design_regex: knowledge_distillation, memory_recall, feature_regression, cross_modal_latent_prediction (momentum teacher or prediction of audio targets/latents)

topics.inclusion_rule: Visual-only WER on the LRS3 test set, any training regime (published rule kept); for the run-variability count, surveys and the corpus paper are excluded.
topics.design_field: M03 supervision_kind; plus full-text spread regex at the target's time
topics.metric: LRS3 VSR WER; repetition (seeds / runs / spread)
